title: The newsletter — Open Circuit SF
description: Subscribe to the Open Circuit SF newsletter, choose your topics in the preference center, and unsubscribe in one click.

intro.text: The newsletter tells you about new events. You pick the topics you care about, and you can change them or leave at any time.

blocks.text: Enter your email address and pick your topics on the
Signup uses double opt-in. After you submit the form, you see "Check your email" and we send a confirmation link. Nothing else is sent to you until you click that link.
Every email has a "Manage your interests" link. It opens the preference center, where you can change your interests or leave the list.
There are three ways to leave:

items: your mail app’s own Unsubscribe button, which works straight away with one click
the "Unsubscribe from everything" link in the footer of every email
"Leave the list" in the preference center
